messages:
malik: Quick heads-up — ran a microbatch profiling sweep on the 1F1B pipeline after the kernel-selector change. Seeing a 15-22% tail latency increase on 8-GPU runs. nvprof/snaps below.
ana: when did we deploy that selector change?
jess: yesterday afternoon? thought we gated it behind the seq_len flag. :thinking:  
malik: rolled 2025-11-03 17:10 UTC, commit 3a4f2d. It picks fused-attention kernels for seq_len > 1024.
liam: drop the raw numbers pls.
malik: baseline median step latency ~120ms -> now ~145ms. p99 340ms -> ~470ms. All-reduce saw ~30ms extra overhead per step on average.
malik: nvprof snippet: 
```
==PROF== PID 12345: cudaLaunchKernel(... fused_attn)  +0.12ms
==PROF== NCCL: allReduce start +30.4ms duration 28.9ms
==PROF== GPU idle gaps: ~10-20ms per device at EPOCH boundaries
```
jess: forcing legacy kernel brings p99 back to ~355ms?
malik: yes. quick A/B: legacy path -> p99 355ms, median 127ms. So fused kernel path is correlated with extra comm stalls.
ana: could be microbatch timing jitter — we tweaked adaptive-split last week to favor fewer microbatches for latency.
liam: also saw KV cache hit-rate drop in the same rollout?
malik: KV hit-rate fell ~6% on long-seq workloads. That increases compute variance across ranks -> worse comm/compute overlap.
jess: do we have NCCL traces to show rank-skew?
malik: attaching condensed timeline (excerpt): 
```
rank0: compute 0-32ms | allreduce wait 32-64ms | compute 64-96ms
rank1: compute 0-28ms | allreduce wait 28-60ms | compute 60-92ms
rank2: compute 0-40ms | allreduce wait 40-72ms | compute 72-104ms
```
malik: rank2 compute stretched due to KV miss + choosing fused kernel that has a higher dynamic memory fanout. That pushes its allreduce window later and triggers more synchronization.
tara: sounds like two interacting regressions: kernel selection heuristic and KV prefetch/eviction policy.
liam: concrete experiments we should run: 1) pin kernel selection to legacy for seq_len range in question; 2) reduce adaptive-split aggressiveness (force more microbatches) to even the compute load; 3) revert KV prefetch eviction tweak to see hit-rate effect.
jess: also try enabling NCCL async progress / stream priority changes — could hide some wakeups.
malik: I ran a quick microbatch sweep: microbatch=2 -> microbatch=4 reduces p99 from 470ms -> 380ms on fused kernel path. So more microbatches improves overlap (at cost of slightly higher median).
ana: tradeoff acceptable for some latency-sensitive customers. Need metric for cost impact (tokens/sec).
malik: sample perf-record / nvprof commands I used: 
```bash
perf record -g -o /tmp/perf.data -- ./run_inference_batch --config cfg.json
nvprof --profile-child-processes --log-file nvprof.txt ./run_inference_batch ...
python tools/trace_fanout.py nvprof.txt > trace.json
```
malik: also captured kernel selection log: `KERNEL_SELECTOR: chosen=fused_attn seq_len=1280 reason=latency_estimate`
jess: can we add a safety cap: only select fused if predicted compute variance < X and KV-hit-rate > Y?
liam: yes, add two gates: kv_hit_rate > 0.9 and predicted_rank_variance < 0.05. Fallback to legacy otherwise.
tara: I'll spin a canary job with pinned legacy, and another with microbatch=4 + fused, and one with kv-prefetch revert. Scheduling now.
infra-bot: scheduled job runner/1725554321-canary-1 started on sim-8gpu-02 (job id: jr-8821)
malik: thanks. please attach NCCL traces + flamegraphs from each run. We need to show that overlap improves and p99 reduces without killing throughput.
jess: if canary data lines up, we should revert selector change and rework the gating logic before next deploy.
liam: don't forget to add a perf regression alert tied to the kernel-selector flag so future flips auto-fire a test sweep.
ana: agree. also add a small eval set of long-seq prompts to the QoL nightly to track KV hit-rate trends.
tara: will run the three canaries over next 2 hours, post short summaries here.
malik: TL;DR: fused kernel alone looks good on uniform compute, but combined with KV misses + adaptive microbatch changes it creates rank variance -> higher all-reduce stalls. Fixes: revert selector or add gating; tune microbatcher; revert kv eviction tweak.
jess: :+1: keep it concise in the PR when reverting. list the metric diffs.
ana: tagging infra team too if we need NCCL tuning: @liam already on it. :eyes:
malik: attaching quick CSV of the runs to the job artifacts. Will post links once available.
infra-bot: job jr-8821 finished: artifacts uploaded to gs://redwood-sim/perf/1725554321/jr-8821/
tara: first run results: legacy-pin p99 358ms, fused+mb=4 p99 372ms, fused+mb=2 p99 420ms. KV-revert run in progress.
malik: cool. once KV-revert numbers in, we decide revert vs gate.
jess: thanks all. keep thread small updates only.
